scope.supports: Kernel-checked, for every glyph alphabet and every stage: in the transcription of the pinned SnCarrier definitions (glyph alphabet abstracted, one-field wrappers flattened; restated, not imported) every accepted outcome of r_n is a section image with the base presentation as payload (accepted_only_from_section, accepted_iff), r_n refuses exactly the presentations that are no section image at that stage (nonDescent_iff_off_image), a section image at another stage is refused (retraction_stage_strict), sectionLift is injective (sectionLift_injective), and the image test is decided by the outcome (inImage_iff); the restated pair (sectionLift n, retrB n), with the outcome read as Base + Unit, is a SectionRetraction of the abstract part (sn_is_section_retraction), so refusal is exactly the absence of a base presentation lifting to p (sn_refused_iff_off_image); in the abstract setting of a section s and a retraction r with the old-image law and soundness, r refuses exactly off the image of s, the round trip s(r y) = y fails exactly off the image (refused_iff_off_image, roundtrip_fails_off_image), and the soundness hypothesis cannot be dropped (abstract instance on Fin 1 -> Fin 2; for S(n), laxRetr obeys the law and never refuses for every alphabet, and lax_breaks_refusal_characterisation is an instance on Bool glyphs at stage 0). refuseOffImage constructs a sound refusing retraction by testing the round trip (refuseOffImage_isSectionRetraction, toy_refused_iff_odd), so refusal-iff-off-image is circular by construction there and is not evidence for the S(n) statement. All S(n) re-proofs report propext only. Native: on eight explicit universes of presentations (up to 866 elements) the pinned lift and retraction are executed: refusal equals off-image with zero violations, payloads are correct, the round trip holds on exactly the image and fails on exactly the refused points, other-stage lifts and over-long bodies are refused, and the lax retraction recovers every base presentation (lax_law_holds) while refusing nothing (lax_refused = 0; both columns are by-construction consequences, the Lean file carries the statement); plus five toy sections x -> c x with exact on-image and refused counts.
scope.does_not_support: The claim that this closes the domain-restriction half of ledger row WDP-P001-019 (a ledger interpretation, not examined); the external prompt file fable_theorems_2026-10-17/05_sn_off_image_refusal.md named in the DAG source list, which was not read; off-image refusal for sections other than the five base shapes (nested lift, retraction or refusal terms as base members are outside the model); any cardinality claim about Carrier n or the declared table (node PG-SN-CARRIER); unrestricted old-image recovery (ledger row WDP-P001-019 stays a negative boundary for the unrestricted interface); the 36-glyph source alphabet beyond the generic statement, and alphabets above three glyphs in the native universes; wire parsing of the source grammar; decidability beyond this syntactic model (the source itself says the image condition is not a general computability theorem); the circular reading in which off-image is defined as failure of the round trip; any physical interpretation.
scope.narrowest_claim: For a restatement over an arbitrary glyph alphabet of the pinned S(n) section and retraction (five base shapes at a given stage), the retraction refuses exactly the presentations that are not section images at that stage, and the restated pair is a section/retraction pair (law and soundness) in the abstract sense, where refusal is the failure of the round trip s(r(p)) = p; this rests on the soundness of the specific retraction (accepted_only_from_section), because the old-image law alone is satisfied by a retraction that refuses nothing.
scope.next_test: With the bridge sn_is_section_retraction proved, extend the refusal characterisation to a grammar that admits nested lift, retraction and refusal terms as base members: add them to Base, restate sectionLift and retr on the enlarged type, and decide whether accepted_only_from_section and sectionLift injectivity still hold or whether a new off-image class appears.
